type.note: required, no fallback (RFC §7 Q5); selects the tag label and glyph

title.note: optional serif title; absent → no <h3> is rendered

children.note: the body: rich inline content (bold, glossary terms)

a11y.semanticStructure: <article> holding, in order, the tag (plain text: Key concept / Pro tip / Trap — the type's meaning), an optional <h3> under the section's <h2>, and the body. No ARIA role overrides; the uppercase tag is CSS text-transform, AT reads the author's casing.
a11y.keyboard: Nothing to do: no interactive element inside the component. Interactive children (glossary terms) keep their own semantics, product-side.
a11y.decisions: The glyph (diamond / circle / triangle, 10px) is decorative — aria-hidden, no alternative text, the label already says it (RFC §7 Q3). Contrast is computed by the gate from resolved tokens: accent/default on surface/default (tag), fg/dim on surface/default (body), fg/default on surface/default (title, bold).
a11y.notes: Implemented per RFC §4; this status moves to pass only through the accessibility engine gate, never by assertion.
